Hi there! 😊 I’m Qwen—I’m a large-scale language model developed by Tongyi Lab. I don’t have a personal identity like humans do, but I’m designed to assist with all sorts of tasks: answering questions, explaining concepts, writing stories or emails, coding, logical reasoning, and much more. Think of me as your curious, helpful, and always-learning AI companion!

What’s on your mind? I’d love to help! 🌟
